The United Federation of Planets is a collection of space-faring species spanning a large area of the Alpha Quadrant. It was founded by the Vulcans, Humans, Andorians, and Tellarites in 2161. The Federation has expanded to many more members and continues to grow in size and influence throughout the galaxy.

The Orion Syndicate act as the major broker between Independents and passing traders in the center of Independent space. Their grand institution of organized crime and illegal activity is widely accepted as uncontrollable by Starfleet, so the Orions have become the dominant force in the neutral pockets of space between the three major galactic superpowers, much to the dismay of their neighbouring rivals, the Nausicaans and Rigelians.

The Augments are a relic of a time long past, a testament to the violent history of humankind. Bred for warfare, they were designed to be stronger, faster and more intelligent than even the most remarkable humans. So great was their power that they were able to overthrow Earth’s governments in a bloody conflict.

Scoundrel, thief, misfit, outcast. To many, these would be met as insults. To Harry Mudd, however? They are the greatest compliments one could receive. Harry Mudd and his Rogues are a ragtag group of the galaxy's greatest thieves, con men, hackers, and enforcers. This outfit of miscreants specializes in large scale heists and with their unique blend of expertise and unbelievable luck, they have yet to be caught.

Almost a millennium and a half after the unification of the planet of Kronos, the Klingon Empire has expanded to encompass a huge area of space spanning the Beta Quadrant. Power is held by the High Council, led by the Klingon Chancellor who leads this war-hungry military hierarchy in their bid to conquer the galaxy.

The Bajorans, one of the oldest cultures in the Alpha Quadrant; a deeply spiritual society of artists, scientists and thinkers. The once peaceful Bajorans were forced to take arms when their world was occupied by the brutal Cardassians. So they understand the importance of resisting oppression. Aided by their faith in the Prophets of the Celestial Temple, a mysterious wormhole in Bajoran space, they are ready to fight so no one else suffers as they have done.

The Ex-Borg are defined not by what they are, but by what they are not. They are not Borg. They are not machines. They are simply people trying their hardest to reclaim a life that was taken from them. These refugees are reviled for their indelible link to a race that inspires a deep and primal fear, while their tech is coveted by those seeking power and profit. The Ex-Borg are fighting for their very right to exist in a galaxy that wishes they didn’t.

An autonomous division of Starfleet Intelligence, Section 31 protects the Federation and its citizens from the most dangerous of threats - the ones no one even realizes exist. Though most high-ranking members of Starfleet would deny knowledge of this covert organization, they are happy to let Section 31 operate in the shadows. After all, a utopia cannot exist without someone willing to get their hands dirty to protect it.

The Romulan Star Empire is publicly led by the Romulan Senate, but is, in reality, controlled by a network of operatives and spies called the Tal Shiar. Outwardly hostile, but typically a defensive presence, the Romulans have carved a large portion of the Beta Quadrant as their sovereign territory.

The Andorian Imperial Guard acts as one of the most potent defense forces in the Federation. As a founding member, the Andorians have a strong influence with Starfleet and work closely with them to protect their borders. Andorians are very confrontational in nature and have made many enemies in the recent events surrounding the Cold War. Their warships patrol near Independent space in anticipation of conflict.

Since the destruction of their homeworld at the hands of the renegade Romulan, Nero, the last surviving Vulcans have banded together in search of a colony to call home. New Vulcan, situated near the Romulan Neutral Zone has been established and acts as home of the Vulcan Science Academy. Their goal is to rebuild their culture, under the protection of Starfleet and the Federation.

The Gorn Hegemony have lived under Klingon control for decades with their King reporting directly to the Klingon Chancellor. Originally from an unknown distant region of space, the Gorn settled in the Beta Quadrant after many years of expansion and exploration. Their reptilian appearance makes them appear ferociously hostile, but their social structure is as complex as any in the known galaxy.

The Arkonians are a technologically advanced race that co-exist with the Klingons in the Beta Quadrant. Despite having been subservient to the Empire in the past, they are views as honorable and formidable allies in recent years by the High Council. The Arkonians were quick to condemn Starfleet for their incursion on Kronos in 2259 and have been aggressively building an armada of ships in anticipation of retaliation.

With the Empress ousted and a power vacuum creating chaos on Terra, enterprising Terrans are taking things into their own hands. It's everyone for themselves, but there are alliances to be made. If you can prove your worth, that is. But keep your wits about you. Terrans are always on the lookout for the next knife aimed at their back. You would be wise to follow suit.
The Department of Temporal Investigations has been called upon to put a stop to the Krenim's temporal incursions. Lucky for all of us, the boys at the DTI are always on time.

The nomadic Suliban are recovering from near-extinction in the late 22nd century. Ruled by a corrupt Cabal since their homeworld was left uninhabitable, the Suliban people overthrew their oppressive rulers and took shelter behind the Romulan border. Now, the Suliban Cabal and the Nomads are closer than ever to putting their differences aside and unifying as one people.

Maverick Faction is an alliance of independent peacekeepers who protect the vulnerable in fringe territories and conflict zones. While they operate independently, Mavericks unite swiftly when needed, pooling resources for righteous causes. So far, the Mavericks have been slowly and surely earning their reputation as vigilantes, folk heroes, and defenders of the bereft, with many relying on their help when all other hope is lost.

The Corvallen are a close ally of the Tal Shiar, the intelligence agency that runs the Romulan Star Empire. Their close ties are a result of a long-standing history of working together to conquer vast areas of the Beta Quadrant. The Corvallen have little interest in holding territory, instead taking heavy compensation from their Romulan allies in the form of technology and resources. They are very powerful military allies and are integral to holding the Romulan line against the Klingons.

Improve your reputation with a Faction to avoid hostile encounters with
them and to <color=#66ff66>unlock Faction purchases</color> in the store.
Earn Federation points from missions, events, and killing hostiles in other factions' space to unlock the Federation store.
Earn Augment points by researching the Botany Bay Ship Commission in the Ascension Tree or from missions.
Earn Rogue points from missions and events to unlock the Rogue store.
Earn Bajoran points from missions and events, and daily bundle exchanges to unlock the Bajoran store.
Earn Klingon points from missions, events, and killing hostiles in other factions' space to unlock the Klingon store.
Complete the mission chain "Doctor, Tailor, Soldier, Spy" available at Operations level 35+ through the Holodeck, to unlock the Bajoran store.
To unlock the store, complete the mission "We Are People Too" (Ops level 38+). Gather faction credits and reputation by completing Daily Goals (available the day after unlocking the store).
Unlock the Section 31 store by claiming the Wave Defense Unlock bundle available in the Gifts section for all players level 30 and above.
Earn Romulan points from missions, events, and killing hostiles in other factions' space to unlock the Romulan store.
Unlock the Terran Faction by reaching Ops 40 and claiming the launch day bundle in the Gifts section or completing the mission "Let the Games Begin" (available in the Holodeck).
Unlock the DTI Faction by claiming the DTI Building Unlock Bundle available to all players level 42 and above.
Complete the mission chain "The Warp Dive Part 1" available at Operations level 55+ through the gifts section to unlock the Maverick store and tasks.

Earn faction points from faction missions, events, and killing faction hostiles in faction space.

Earning or losing enough points will change your reputation with that faction.

Positive reputation with a faction will allow you to purchase items from that faction’s store with that faction’s currency.

Negative reputation with the Federation, Klingon, and Romulan factions may cause faction hostiles to attack your ships on sight.

Positive reputation with the Augment faction may cause bounty hunters in Augment space to attack your ships on sight.

Maverick Faction Tasks refresh every week. Take on solo and alliance tasks to get Maverick Credits and Renown. Locked Tasks Unlock tasks with Maverick Task Keys. Get Maverick Task Keys every week from the Maverick Faction store. This chest can be unlocked by upgrading the Warp Dive Bar building. The Warp Dive Bar level 20: 100 keys per week The Warp Dive Bar level 30: 200 keys per week The Warp Dive Bar level 40: 300 keys per week Rotating Tasks Every week, the final 2 tasks on the list will rotate to fresh tasks that involve: Killing Federation, Klingon, or Romulan hostiles of levels 55+ Earn Federation, Klingon, or Romulan reputation points Destroy V'ger hostiles of levels 55+ Destroy Aggregation hostiles of levels 55+ Destroy Transogen hostiles of levels 55+ Destroy Augment Exile hostiles of levels 55+ These could be Solo or Alliance tasks. Task Enhancement Research The Maverick Research tree has 3 research nodes that enhance solo tasks in different ways. Once purchased, these research nodes will only change their tasks during the next task refresh. Your currently available tasks will not change. Glory of the Mavericks - 40% more Maverick Renown from tasks Patrons of the Mavericks - 40% more Maverick Credits from tasks Deeds of the Mavericks - 20% lower milestones for tasks
